note_for_citers: Frozen public-tier slice of the kosha dataset manifest for this release tag. tier=restricted rows are excluded by design and are not part of any published release; consult their source repo. sha256_source=computed means this file records a digest taken from the bytes on disk at freeze time; unavailable means the source was not resolvable locally and the digest is not asserted. datasets.title: Bloomfield 1906 Vedic Concordance — direct Ṛgveda citations (pratīka index)
datasets.keying: maṇḍala + sūkta + verse + pada_letter (a/b/c/d, blank if unlettered) → pratīka text + full raw citation string
datasets.notes: Every direct RV.<mandala>.<sukta>.<verse><pada-letter> citation extracted from Marco Franceschini's digital edition of Maurice Bloomfield's A Vedic Concordance (Harvard Oriental Series 9, 1906) — 88,835 total concordance entries scanned (the concordance indexes the WHOLE Vedic corpus, not just RV), 10,374 distinct RV (mandala,sukta,verse) keys cited. Used to populate parallel_passage_verses.tsv's bloomfield_pratika column for the RV subset (13,581 rows): 11,522 (85%) validated by substring-matching the Bloomfield pratika (parenthetical variant-reading asides stripped, form_key()-normalized, final character dropped to tolerate the pausa-vs-sandhi boundary mismatch) against the row's own recorded source_text — NOT positionally assumed (the row-pair layout is a printed first-half/second-half split, which does not line up 1:1 with Bloomfield's grammatical a/b/c/d pada lettering for 4-pada meters; naive positional mapping would have silently mismatched). Remaining 15% residue is genuine orthographic variance between the two independently-produced digitizations (anusvara-vs-homorganic-nasal spelling, consonant-doubling variants), documented not chased further — full method + counts in data/concordance/BLOOMFIELD_RV_CROSSREF_REPORT.md. RIGHTS: public tier by direct written permission from Marco Franceschini (University of Bologna), non-exclusive/worldwide/perpetual, covering all current and future kosha versions — see data/manifest/rights/franceschini_hos9_permission_2026-07-13.md and LICENSE-DATA.md. Required citation: "Digitization by Marco Franceschini (University of Bologna), of Maurice Bloomfield's A Vedic Concordance (Harvard Oriental Series 9, 1906). Used with permission."

datasets.title: Generated↔attested morphology audit (A3, W1b)
datasets.keying: kosha.db generated inflected forms (forms, include_heritage=False; 426,410 non-heritage rows) joined to DCS attested surface forms (dcs_full.sqlite token.form; 381,413 distinct) on form_key() equality — the length-preserving floor tier, promoted to exact where SLP1 keys are byte-identical (no NFD+strip path, D6/1b-2). Three buckets: AG 401,368 (of 426,410 generated) · G¬A 25,042 · A¬G 2 (of 381,413 attested). Canonical concordance-core schema (anchor_type/anchor_id/anchor_key_slp1/target_locus/match_method/confidence/evidence_count) + gen_source, tense_caveat, attested_form. Confidence from TIER_CONFIDENCE (exact 0.95 · floor 0.85). Loci are host-independent dcs:<sent_id>.
datasets.notes: A3 = the artefact A4 cannot start without (D12). Sidecars in data/concordance/: morph_attest_GnA.tsv (over-generation), morph_attest_AnG.tsv (engine gap), MORPHOLOGY_ATTESTATION_BUILD_REPORT.md. CIRCULARITY: 93.30% of the generated side is itself source='dcs' (ingested DCS surface tokens), so its AG is a 99.99% round-trip; the research-meaningful figure is the vidyut-engine subtotal — AG 3,550 / 28,567 = 12.43% attested, 25,017 over-generated. Consequently A¬G is degenerate (=2: oṃ + one OCR token) and CANNOT measure engine gaps here — reported as the finding, not hidden (genuine_engine_gap=0, nothing routed to the csl-inflect give-back). CONTRADICTION surfaced (STOP-AND-SURFACE, not resolved): the plan set's 6.9M generated figure is `inflections` (6,917,018 rows), not `forms` (1,378,401) — built on forms per the deliverable text; A4's generated-side table is a human call. Read-only build. PUBLICATION GATED on the W1a rights record (H1263 / D2): unreleased until the DCS BY-SA/BY-4.0 licence contradiction is settled.

datasets.title: Graded morphology curriculum — corpus-attested paradigms, ordered teaching syllabus

Learn 4,862 paradigms -> cover 50% of attested nominal/verbal tokens; 6,351 -> 80%; 6,708 -> 90% (bucket-first ordering trades coverage-efficiency for pedagogical class sequencing — an honest, expected tradeoff, not a defect). Teaching page reading/morphology/curriculum/index.html.
datasets.builder: scripts/build_morphology_drills.py + build_morphology_curriculum.py over app/paradigm.py (P4 K2b) + lemma_frequency.tsv (core_rank) + VisualDCS dcs_full.sqlite attestation join
datasets.notes: H946 Wave-1 pedagogy build (W1a). Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns. Drills only forms the corpus actually attests (field RQ1: 'stop drilling forms that never appear') — 38,782/254,805 candidate cells (15.2%) survived the DCS attestation join over the core-vocabulary lemma set; the rest are dropped by default (--include-generated keeps them, flagged attested:false). DCS aggregates by lemma TEXT not lemma_id, so a handful of homonym-shared lemma spellings pool their attestation counts (same simplification H950 already accepted). Verb voice (active/middle) is not part of the attestation match key — DCS's feat_voice marks only passive, an honest upstream tagging limitation.

datasets.notes: H949 kosha pedagogy Wave 2 (W2a), the difficulty spine. ONE estimator, not 'the' difficulty (R5): four corpus-grounded axes -- vocab-frequency x sandhi-density x morphology-rarity x compound-load -- documented in METHODS.md and honestly limited (frequency != learnability, R6; sandhi is a boundary-fusion proxy). Scores only packs carrying UD morphology; the 18 Gita packs (built by build_reading_pack_gita.py from a non-UD source) get a SEPARATE reduced 3-axis ordering instead -- see gita-reading-pack-difficulty (H977) -- never fabricated into this 4-axis score. Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns; source DCS is CC BY 4.0 (Oliver Hellwig / DCS).

datasets.title: Reading-pack per-verse metre annotation (W3a)
datasets.keying: one row per reading-pack sentence: pack, locus, dcs, syllables, metre, metre_type (vrtta/jati), method, confidence, text-preview. Two-tier + null method: strict vrtta via vidyut.chandas (method=vidyut-chandas, confidence=high, requires >=8 syllables); anustubh via a syllable heuristic (method=syllable-heuristic, confidence=medium -- every such tag is a whole-pada multiple of 8 in [8,32], and 840/840 land at exactly 16 = a half-sloka); everything else left unresolved with an empty metre (prose, headings, fragments -- never guessed). Companion metre_coverage.tsv (per-pack distribution + identified %).
datasets.notes: H951 kosha pedagogy Wave 3 (W3a). REUSE/INTEGRATE, not greenfield: NO metre trainer/UI shipped in kosha -- SanskritKaraoke owns that (scope re-checked 15-07, unchanged). Coverage: 12% strict vrtta (high, validated -- Kiratarjuniya-1 scans 92/92 vamsastha, correct for Bharavi's canto 1), 77% anustubh (medium heuristic), 11% unresolved (honest, mostly prose/speaker-tags). Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns; metre engine vidyut (MIT, Arun Prasad); source DCS is CC BY 4.0 (Oliver Hellwig / DCS).

datasets.title: Roots frequency + attestation curriculum (W2b)
datasets.keying: one row per unique DCS lemma (629, deduped from 717 Whitney-hub roots with corpus attestation -- 74 homonym-shared lemmas collapsed to avoid triple-counting the same corpus mass): rank, root_iast (one or more Whitney root strings joined by ' / ' when homonym-shared), dcs_lemma, grammar_class, dcs_status, attested_count, coverage_pct (cumulative), top_attested_forms.
datasets.builder: scripts/build_roots_frequency.py -- REUSE/INTEGRATE, not a re-derivation: reads WhitneyRoots/src/dcs_freq.json (the canonical MW<->Whitney<->DCS triangulation built by WhitneyRoots/scripts/root_triangulation.py from the canonical dcs-full-sqlite ingest) and adds the graded-curriculum framing (rank + cumulative coverage_pct) that source lacks.
datasets.notes: H950 roadmap Wave 2 W2b. Stops at stage 6 (data + export) per the pedagogy-surface architecture's integration-surface rule -- no kosha roots UI shipped; WhitneyRoots owns the 935-root explorer. Coverage headline: learn top 25 roots -> 58.7% of verb-token occurrences; top 50 -> 71.7%; top 100 -> 85.4%; top 200 -> 95.3% (549,549 total attested-lemma tokens, DCS 2026 CoNLL-U snapshot). 181 Whitney-hub roots have no DCS attestation at all and are excluded (grammarian/lexical roots, not corpus-absent by data error). Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns; source DCS is CC BY 4.0 (Oliver Hellwig / DCS).

datasets.title: Samasa (compound) analysis trainer
datasets.keying: one row per gold-verified compound (759; from the 815-row gita-morphology-gold compound column, minus 56 ambiguous dual-tag rows), ordered as a graded syllabus: rank, lesson (1-4 = KD/TP/BV/DV, transparent types first per the MG 14-07-2026 ruling), type, type_name, compound, form, verse, corpus_freq, cumulative_freq_pct. Within a lesson, ranked by corpus frequency (VisualDCS Kompozity names.csv join). Companion data/samasa/reference.tsv (per-type ranked lookup) and data/samasa/samasa_drills.json (3,565 identify/split practice items: 759 gold-verified identify, 806 gold-verified split, 2,000 corpus-derived unverified-type split, capped from a 168,421-item ranked corpus pool per data/samasa/drill_weights.json). Teaching pages reading/samasa/{curriculum,drills,reference}/index.html.
datasets.builder: scripts/build_samasa_trainer.py over data/gita/gita_morphology_gold.tsv (gold type + member split) and VisualDCS derived-data/Kompozity cmps.csv x names.csv (corpus-scale split pool, frequency-ranked)
datasets.notes: H948 kosha pedagogy Wave 1 (docs/IMPLEMENTATION_KOSHA_PEDAGOGY_WAVE1.md §W1c). Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns; source DCS is CC BY-SA 4.0 (Oliver Hellwig / DCS). Type distribution is honestly skewed, not balanced: TP=458, BV=298, DV=2, KD=1 gold examples -- dvandva and karmadharaya are severely underrepresented in the Gita gold set and corpus-derived items cannot fill the gap (no verified type). 9 gold rows (lexicalized bahuvrihis like "govinda") carry no hyphen-segmented lemma and are identify-only, excluded from split.

datasets.title: Graded sandhi curriculum — ordered teaching syllabus
datasets.keying: one row per sandhi rule (2,181), ordered as a graded syllabus: rank, rule, category, count, pct, cumulative_pct, family_size, priority, lesson (10 lessons). Priority = frequency x class x environment-generality (MG ruling 14-07-2026); weights in data/sandhi/difficulty_weights.json (tunable). Learn 23 rules -> read 50% of all corpus sandhi; 79 -> 80%; 132 -> 90%. Teaching page reading/sandhi/curriculum/index.html.
datasets.notes: H902 roadmap Phase 4 (surface 2/4: graded curriculum). Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns. Derived from the corpus-sandhi dataset; weighting is human-tunable per the MG ruling.

datasets.title: Sandhi drills — join/split/identify practice items
datasets.keying: one item per row: id, type (join/split/identify), rule, category, lesson, difficulty, question, answer, choices (4-way MCQ with same-class distractors), context (attested example sentence). 396 items over the 132 curriculum rules covering 90% of corpus sandhi (lessons 1-9; lesson-10 long tail excluded by default, --max-lesson to widen). Also shipped as data/sandhi/sandhi_drills.tsv (flat fallback) and data/sandhi/sandhi_drills.apkg (Anki deck, genanki). Web quiz reading/sandhi/drills/index.html (self-contained MCQ, theme-aware).
datasets.notes: H918 roadmap Phase 4 (surface 4b: drills/flashcards, the last core-programme surface — sibling surface 4a is the SanskritGrammar reader-hover, H917). Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns. Deterministic build (seeded RNG, seed 20260714) so choice ordering/distractors are reproducible across rebuilds.

datasets.title: Sanskrit root x preverb (upasarga) semantics
datasets.keying: 148 verb roots attested in the Gita + 69 preverb-modified senses: root·preverb·combined·sense·count (empty preverb = base sense; √vac speak -> pra-vac declare; √gam go -> ava-gam understand). From the Gita.xlsm verbs sheet; a compositional dimension the Cologne dictionaries lack. Browsable page reading/upasarga/.
datasets.builder: scripts/extract_upasarga_semantics.py + scripts/build_upasarga_page.py (Gita.xlsm verbs sheet, H876 W6)
datasets.notes: H848 roadmap W6 (final workstream). Public/MIT, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns. Data statement docs/data-statements/upasarga-semantics.meta.md. Surfaced on /w/ root cards (app/word_page.py _upasarga_block) + the reading/upasarga/ page.

datasets.title: vidyut-chandas metre definitions (vendored)
datasets.keying: vendored verbatim from vidyut-data/chandas/meters.tsv: meter name, type (vrtta), G/L pattern string. Consumed by vidyut.chandas.Chandas to classify strict vrttas. Vendored so kosha's metre annotator is self-contained (no sibling-clone dependency at build time).
datasets.notes: H951. Upstream: vidyut-data (MIT, Arun Prasad / ambuda-org). Vendored copy pinned; re-sync from vidyut-data if upstream meters change.

datasets.title: Frequency-graded vocabulary curriculum — ordered teaching syllabus
datasets.keying: one row per core-vocabulary lemma (6,667 of 7,120 Leonchenko core_rank lemmas; 453 dropped for having no committed dictionary card), ordered by core_rank: rank, lemma_slp1, deva, iast, gloss, core_rank, coverage_pct, cumulative_pct, lesson (134 lessons of 50), card_href. cumulative_pct is computed here (running sum of the source coverage_pct marginal weight), not copied from the source feed. Learn 284 lemmas -> read 30% of the core-vocabulary corpus mass; 1122 -> 50%; 4978 -> 70%. Teaching page reading/vocabulary/curriculum/index.html.
datasets.notes: H947 Wave-1 pedagogy build (W1b). Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns. Applies the sandhi-curriculum method to words; gloss is the lemma's own dictionary card teaser (MW preferred), not DCS's lemma.meanings (only ~23% coverage on this lemma set, rejected as primary source).

datasets.title: Vocabulary drills — recognition/recall practice items
datasets.keying: one item per row: aspect=vocabulary, type (recognition: word->gloss / recall: gloss->word), prompt, answer, distractors (same-lesson-band lemmas), rank (core_rank), evidence (docs/cards/<token>.json), source_dataset=vocab-curriculum (ARCHITECTURE shared item schema). 2 items per curriculum lemma (6,667 x 2 = 13,334). Also shipped as data/frequency/vocab_curriculum.apkg (Anki deck, genanki, one Basic note per lemma: front=deva/iast, back=gloss).
datasets.notes: H947 Wave-1 pedagogy build (W1b). Public/MIT pedagogy layer, credit Dr. Marcis Gasuns. No SRS scheduling here (deck items only, per the fence in H947 — Systema "Saraswati" owns scheduling).
